name: net.dalvivo/catalogue
title: DalVivo
description: Find events, places and day plans in Italy. Free read-only access with links and source attribution.

tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Resolve a town name to coordinates before geographic searches. Multiple matches require disambiguation. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

q.description: Town or locality name, at least 2 characters, e.g. "Bergamo" or "Castione della Presolana". Matches by prefix.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find events by date, coordinates, keywords, free admission and family suitability. Geographic filters require both coordinates. Maximum 10 results per page. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

cursor.description: Opaque page.next_cursor from the previous call with the same arguments. Omit for the first page.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

radius_m.description: Search radius in straight-line metres from lat/lng, 1000 to 100000. Requires lat and lng; without it, lat/lng only rank results by proximity.

q.description: Keywords matched against event titles and descriptions, e.g. "jazz", "sagra castagne". Omit to browse.

date_from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Rome). Keeps events still running on or after this day.

date_to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Rome). Keeps events starting on or before this day. Not before date_from.

family_only.description: true: only events marked suitable for families with children.

free_only.description: true: only events whose source says admission is free. Events with unknown price are excluded.

age.description: A participant's age in years: only events whose stated age range includes it. Events with no stated range are excluded.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the event listing language, e.g. "it" or "en".

sort.description: upcoming (default): soonest first, weighted by proximity and listing quality. relevance: best keyword match, requires q. date: chronological. distance: nearest first, requires lat and lng.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get a published event by its id from search_events. Includes status, source and freshness when available. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find places around coordinates. Groups: outdoors, heritage, family, all. Opening hours and accessibility are unverified source data. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

radius_m.description: Search radius in straight-line metres from lat/lng, 1000 to 100000. Default 30000 (30 km).

cursor.description: Opaque page.next_cursor from the previous call with the same arguments. Omit for the first page.

group.description: outdoors: parks, viewpoints, gardens, lakes, waterfalls, peaks, mountain huts. heritage: museums, castles, monuments, galleries. family: zoos, aquariums, theme and adventure parks, water parks, planetariums. all (default): every type.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Get a place by its id from search_places, including OpenStreetMap and description attribution. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

id.description: Place id returned by search_places, e.g. "poi:osm-node-123456".

tools.name: search_day_plans
tools.description: Find available day plans around coordinates for a date and audience. Returns ids for get_day_plan. Does not create a new itinerary. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

radius_m.description: Search radius in straight-line metres from lat/lng, 1000 to 100000. Default 30000 (30 km).

cursor.description: Opaque page.next_cursor from the previous call with the same arguments. Omit for the first page.

date.description: Day of the outing, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Rome): only plans that can be followed that day. Omit for any upcoming day.

audience.description: Who the plan is for: family (with children), couple, friends, or active (sporty). Omit for all.

tools.name: get_day_plan
tools.description: Get a public itinerary by its id from search_day_plans. Check live and validity dates; hidden itineraries are unavailable. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

id.description: Day plan id (UUID) returned by search_day_plans.
